items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: Like that dance once, when they had Peyton, you used to kick for the ham. You heard of Peyton, an old accordion player.

ctx.x: And Buddy Johnson. Now, they have two special halls in Al Jays. They had on Sigwin Street, it was the Oddfellas Hall. They had the Hall on Olivia, on Valette. And Evelyn, the Second Hall of Marys Hall. The Johnson Band. I think you showed us one of those halls buildings. We were up in that section. Yeah. They had a reason for that. Now, I said a leader of the Johnson Band would always play at the Second Hall of Marys Hall. They had a reason for that. He was a leader of the Johnson Band. He was a leader of the…
The ham hanging on the string? Yeah.
